explication: Sidekick is a CLI for provisioning a VPS and deploying Dockerfile-based applications to it. The main workflow is init (prepare the server and its Docker/Traefik environment), launch (build and transfer an app, then configure routing), and deploy (ship later versions); preview deployments add commit-specific environments that can be listed or removed. Local configuration, SSH access, and secret handling support these workflows. The README documents SSL, load balancing, and SOPS-backed secrets. Some command implementations are unsampled, so links to those subsystems are limited to documented behavior.
